outcome: Let named CyberAlchemy consumers refer to Persons and Teams and preserve explicit membership, roles, and responsibilities without confusing participation, ownership, accounts, permissions, or authority.
scope: Define and validate candidate Person, Team, Team Membership, Team Role, and Responsibility meaning; keep references closed, privacy-minimizing, lifecycle-aware, and non-authoritative; prepare later DomainSpec and runtime work without selecting an identity or directory implementation.
exclusions: storing credentials, legal identity evidence, private attributes, or unnecessary contact data
implementing authentication, authorization, human resources, payroll, organization charts, or a directory service
inferring Team membership from accounts, chat channels, repositories, or access groups
inferring roles, responsibilities, ownership, permissions, or authority from membership
claiming that a schema-valid Person or Team instance exists outside the modeled context
